decisions.llmReasoning: Replacing a water-damaged built-in microwave is fundamentally different from a cabinet moisture content verification test. Different work scope, different trade, different totals.

Power washing siding and windows is exterior cleaning work; a roofing system certification and warranty is a documentation/inspection service. Different trades, different units, fundamentally different scope.

Emergency storm mitigation first response (labor hours) is hands-on remediation work; a structural engineering assessment report is a professional inspection/reporting service. Different scope, different units, different totals.
Smoke/soot cleaning of a concrete floor is cleaning work measured in square feet; replacing a garage door opener is an equipment replacement task. Completely different scope, trade, and units.
Painting exterior soffit panels is a painting trade task; an independent roofing final inspection is an inspection service. Different trades, different units, fundamentally different scope.

Replacing tub spout and shower trim in a hall bathroom is plumbing work; a hardwood floor moisture content test in the main living room is a flooring inspection. Different zones, different trades, different scope entirely.

Air scrubber rental for attic drying is temporary drying equipment; replacing a powered attic ventilation fan is a permanent equipment replacement. Different scope, different units, different purpose.

Thermal imaging scan for hidden moisture is a specific diagnostic tool/service; a post-storm building envelope integrity test is a different type of inspection. Different descriptions, different quantities (3 vs 2), and different totals suggest different line items despite both being general condition inspections.

Replacing a freestanding soaking tub is a plumbing fixture replacement; a mold remediation assessment is an inspection/testing service. Different scope, different trade, and vastly different totals ($2220 vs $336).
